'''Sina "Blood Tooth" Farther''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Farther was one of the leaders of [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt]] forces in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He piloted a [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighter]].<ref name="SWG:Ys" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempHutt.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Sina "Blood Tooth" Farther]]
Sina "Blood Tooth" Farther appeared aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Ys" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sina Farther was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Sina "Blood Tooth" Farther was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Hutt starfighters in the Yavin system.<ref name="SWG:Ys" />
